prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的句子結構。
text: _____ the committee reviewed the data earlier, the error would have been caught.
options: Had
If had
Has
Would

wrong.If had: 倒裝句省略 if，Had 已經取代了 if，不能同時出現。
wrong.Has: Has 是現在完成式助動詞，不符合與過去事實相反的假設。
wrong.Would: Would 用在主要子句，不能用來開頭假設。

why: 與過去事實相反的假設可以省略 if，把 had 提到句首，句型為 Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞。
tip: If I had known = Had I known，是過去假設的倒裝。
say: Had the committee reviewed the data earlier, the error would have been caught.

prompt: 圖表顯示出席人數下降，文章卻說會員增加。下列哪個解釋能同時說明兩份資料？
text: Chart: monthly attendance fell. Article: total membership grew.
options: 新會員很多，但每個人到場的次數變少
圖表一定錯誤，文章才可信
文章一定錯誤，圖表才可信
會員增加表示出席人數一定上升
answer: 新會員很多，但每個人到場的次數變少

wrong.圖表一定錯誤，文章才可信: 沒有證據證明圖表有誤，不能直接否定其中一份資料。
wrong.文章一定錯誤，圖表才可信: 同樣沒有依據，兩份資料可能衡量不同東西。
wrong.會員增加表示出席人數一定上升: 會員數和出席次數是不同指標，並非必然連動。

why: 總會員數與每月到場次數衡量不同事，可以同時成立，這是整合雙文本的關鍵。
tip: 兩份資料矛盾時，先檢查它們衡量的是否同一件事。
say: Membership grew, but attendance per member fell.

prompt: 哪一句話使用 despite 正確？
options: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued.
Despite of the heavy rain, the match continued.
Despite the rain was heavy, the match continued.
Despite it rained heavily, the match continued.
answer: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued.

wrong.Despite of the heavy rain, the match con: despite 後面不加 of；in spite of 才有 of。
wrong.Despite the rain was heavy, the match co: despite 後面接名詞片語，不能直接接完整子句。
wrong.Despite it rained heavily, the match con: 同樣，despite 後面不接子句；要改用 although。

why: despite 是介系詞，後面接名詞或動名詞，不接子句，也不加 of。
say: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued.

prompt: 你想形容一位考生在高壓下依然保持沉著，哪句最自然？
options: She kept her composure even under heavy pressure.
She kept her composition even under heavy pressure.
She keeps composed her even under heavy pressure.
She was composure even for pressure heavy.
answer: She kept her composure even under heavy pressure.

wrong.She kept her composition even under heav: composition 是「作文、組成」，composure 才是沉著、鎮定。
wrong.She keeps composed her even under heavy: composed 位置錯誤，這裡需要名詞 composure 當 keep 的受詞。
wrong.She was composure even for pressure heav: was 後面不能直接接名詞表示狀態，heavy 也放在 pressure 後面，語序錯誤。

why: keep one's composure 是固定搭配，意思是保持鎮定。
tip: keep one's composure = 保持鎮定。
say: She kept her composure even under heavy pressure.

text: The author's tone is _____: she never states her opinion, but the word choices hint at it.
options: subtle
severe
sudden
simple

wrong.severe: severe 是「嚴厲的」，但句子說作者沒有明說意見，不是嚴厲。
wrong.sudden: sudden 是「突然的」，與暗示的語氣無關。
wrong.simple: simple 是簡單，而句子說用詞間接暗示，並不是簡單直白。

why: never states her opinion 與 hint at it 說明語氣含蓄，subtle 就是「細微的、不明顯的」。
tip: 含蓄不明說的語氣，就是 subtle。

prompt: 這句話的 implication 是什麼？
text: The report notes that most complaints came from one district, which implies that the problem may be local.
options: 問題可能只發生在特定地區
所有地區都有同樣的問題
報告沒有任何抱怨
這個地區沒有人投訴
answer: 問題可能只發生在特定地區

wrong.所有地區都有同樣的問題: most complaints came from one district，表示集中在一區。
wrong.報告沒有任何抱怨: 報告有提到 complaints，所以並非沒有。
wrong.這個地區沒有人投訴: 該區就是投訴最多的地方。

why: imply 是暗示，大部分投訴來自同一區，所以可推論問題偏向局部。
tip: imply 是文章暗示的結論，不一定明說。

prompt: 哪一句的 not only ... but also 用法正確？
options: Not only did she win the prize, but she also donated it.
Not only she won the prize, but she also donated it.
Not only did she won the prize, but also donated it.
Not only she did win the prize, but she donated it also.
answer: Not only did she win the prize, but she also donated it.

wrong.Not only she won the prize, but she also: Not only 放句首時要倒裝，應為 did she win。
wrong.Not only did she won the prize, but also: did 後面動詞要用原形 win，不能用 won。
wrong.Not only she did win the prize, but she: 倒裝順序應為 did she，且 also 位置不自然。

why: Not only 放句首引起倒裝：Not only + 助動詞 + 主詞 + 原形動詞。
tip: Not only 放句首，後面要倒裝。
say: Not only did she win the prize, but she also donated it.

prompt: 你想形容一次測驗是整個學期學習的總結，哪個詞最合適？
options: culmination
cultivation
culprit
cumulus

wrong.cultivation: cultivation 是「栽培、培養」，不是頂點或總結。
wrong.culprit: culprit 是「犯人」，與總結學習無關。
wrong.cumulus: cumulus 是「積雲」，是天氣用語。

why: culmination 表示最高點或集大成，適合形容一段過程的最終成果。
tip: culmination 是一段過程的最高點。
say: The exam is the culmination of the semester.

prompt: 哪一個結論與下列敘述最一致？
text: Few students passed the test, yet the teacher was pleased because the test was far harder than last year's.
options: 老師認為通過率低是合理的
老師對成績很生氣
測驗比去年簡單
大部分學生通過了考試
answer: 老師認為通過率低是合理的

wrong.老師對成績很生氣: 文中 pleased 表示滿意，不是生氣。
wrong.測驗比去年簡單: 原文說 far harder，是更難。
wrong.大部分學生通過了考試: Few students passed 表示只有少數人通過。

why: yet 引出反差，因測驗比去年難很多，所以低通過率仍使老師滿意。
tip: yet 引出出乎意料的反差，答案常在其後。
say: The teacher was pleased because the test was harder.
